$ headroom accounts add --share-config=$BASE/shared-config d@x.com
exit 0
--- stdout
seeded $BASE/home/.claude-accounts/d@x.com
  projects → $BASE/home/.claude/projects (sessions are machine-global)
  shared from $BASE/shared-config: skills
next: HOME=$BASE/home headroom launch --account d@x.com   then /login as d@x.com
      (the board warns if the login does not match the dir name; new accounts sort last until listed in $BASE/home/.claude-accounts/.order)
--- stderr
